Hello! Today we learn about Earliest Converts in Islam • Khadija (R.A.) • Ali (R.A.) • Abubakar (R.A.). Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

2. Explain Earliest Converts in Islam • Khadija (R.A.) • Ali (R.A.) • Abubakar (R.A.) to a parent using one local example.

4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.
